subject: Evidence request: CVE-2027-0457 remediation and scan cadence details
messages:
From: Sanjay Gupta <s.gupta@clearwave.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@clearwave.com
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence request: CVE-2027-0457 remediation + scan cadence for SIG

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the conversation earlier. As part of our SIG/SOC 2 evidence collection, we need formal artifacts for CVE-2027-0457 (remote code execution in libfastqueue) showing the following:

- Confirmation the vulnerable component was identified in your inventory and the affected services.
- The remediation/patch applied (commit or package id) and exact deployment windows.
- Post-deploy verification (scan log snippet or validation checklist).
- The cadence of VM scans you run (how often, scope, owner).
- Any rolling/canary rollback plan used for the patch wave.

Can you provide a single packet with the items above plus a short attestation we can include in our SIG review? Ideally PDF, and if you can sign on company letterhead or provide a DocuSign link that would be great.

We have an internal deadline on Oct 22 to close the evidence queue — would you be able to deliver by EOD Oct 18?

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Gupta
Senior Auditor, ClearWave Compliance
S: +1 415-555-0123

From: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Gupta <s.gupta@clearwave.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: CVE-2027-0457 remediation + scan cadence for SIG

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a consolidated packet. High level answers up front: 

- Inventory & affected services: affected runtime: inference-gateway v2.14 (container image sha256: d9f6a...) — we include the SBOM slice in the packet.
- Remediation: patch applied via package release rwinf-2.14.3 (cherry-pick commit 7a9c3f). Production deploy window: 2027-10-10 02:00 — 2027-10-10 04:30 UTC across active regions.
- Post-deploy verification: full internal VM scan completed 2027-10-11 06:12 UTC; we include the scan output (trimmed) and a validation checklist.
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated scans for production surfaces; daily lightweight health checks for canary clusters; quarterly authenticated full-surface scans for third-party dependencies. Owner: Vulnerability Ops (kimberly_park).
- Canary + rollback plan: 2% canary for 2 hours, extend to 20% for 6 hours; rollback window 30 minutes automated if error rate spike >1.5x baseline.

We are attaching: cve-2027-0457-remediation-summary.pdf (details and timelines), scan-cadence-2027Q3.csv (export of recent runs), and deployment-logs-patchwave-20271010.tar.gz (redacted logs). We will follow up with a signed attestation on letterhead.

Deliverable ETA: draft packet by EOD Oct 16; signed attestation by EOD Oct 18. Please confirm if that timeline meets your queue.

Thanks,

— Mateo Alvarez
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

From: Sanjay Gupta <s.gupta@clearwave.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@clearwave.com
Date: Sun, 17 Oct 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: CVE-2027-0457 remediation + scan cadence for SIG

Mateo — appreciate the quick turnaround. Draft packet works. Two items before you finalize the signed attestation: 

1) The attestation needs an explicit line: "Redwood Inference attests that CVE-2027-0457 has been remediated in production and monitored per the scan cadence described, and no active instances of the vulnerable component remain as of the date of signing."

2) In the remediation summary, can you include the exact package id or CVE-fix commit hash and the artifact repository URL where we can independently pull metadata?

If you can include those in the signed letterhead PDF, we can close this item.

Thanks — Sanjay

From: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>

Sanjay — attached is the final packet and signed attestation. Notes: 

- The attestation includes the sentence you requested verbatim.
- Fix commit hash: 7a9c3f2b84d6c9a1b2f8a4c0d3e5f9b12a6c3d9e (also published to our artifact registry at https://artifacts.redwood.com/rwinf/2.14.3).
- We included a short provenance table and a hashed pointer to the deployment artifact (sha256: 6f2b... truncated in public doc). Full logs and provenance are available to auditors under an NDA; if ClearWave needs that, we can open a secure transfer.

Attached: signed-attestation-clearwave-letterhead.pdf (DocuSign completed), cve-2027-0457-remediation-summary.pdf, scan-cadence-2027Q3.csv, deployment-logs-patchwave-20271010.tar.gz.

If you want a compact cover email tailored for the SIG portal we can create that as well — cc'ing Kim to coordinate.

Best,
Mateo
